summary: Central Elections Committee chair Justice Noam Sohlberg ordered Ben-Gvir to remove a May 20 video filmed inside an Israel Prison Service detention facility with uniformed personnel and bound flotilla activists, finding the publication constituted election propaganda using public assets.
notes: Verified through Kan's report of the operative CEC ruling and independent Times of Israel reporting; the Movement for Quality Government preserves the precise costs split: NIS 8,000 against Ben-Gvir personally plus NIS 15,000 jointly against the National Security Ministry and IPS.
